description: Singapore resident labour force participation rate (LFPR), aged 15+. Defaults to the overall total rate; use `indicator` for an age band (e.g. '25 - 29 Years'). Annual (end-June), from MOM/DOS via SingStat (M182201).

indicator.description: Series to return (substring match). Default 'Total Resident Participation Rate'. Age bands like '25 - 29 Years' are available.

name: sg_labour_force
